title: Zesty Crisp Norwegian Cauliflower Toast
description: A kid-friendly Norwegian dish featuring charred and crisp cauliflower on toast, perfect for a plant-based snack. This recipe is easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the cauliflower florets with olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder in a bowl until they are evenly coated.
Spread the cauliflower on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until charred and crisp.
Toast the whole wheat bread slices until they are lightly browned.
Spread a layer of lemon juice on each toast slice.
Top each toast slice with a portion of the roasted cauliflower.
Sprinkle nutritional yeast over the cauliflower if using.
Serve the Zesty Crisp Norwegian Cauliflower Toast hot and enjoy.
